saints.name: St. Saturninus of Toulouse
saints.title: Bishop and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The first bishop of Toulouse, dragged to his death by a bull for refusing to worship idols…
biography: Saturninus, called Sernin in his own city, was the first bishop of Toulouse in Gaul, sent to preach the Gospel in the third century. He is remembered for his fearless proclamation of Christ and for drawing many from the worship of the pagan gods.

According to his ancient passion, when he refused to offer sacrifice he was bound to a bull being led to the altar and dragged to his death down the steps of the Capitol, about the year 257. The church of Notre-Dame du Taur marks the place of his martyrdom, and his relics rest in the great basilica of Saint-Sernin at Toulouse.
saints.knownFor: The first bishop and martyr of Toulouse.
